package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for gin_handler_uses_action_param_switch_for_many_use_cases: Handlers that branch on `action`, `type`, or mode strings to serve many workflows from one endpoint function.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func TaskHandler(c *gin.Context) {
	action := c.Query("action")

	switch action {
	case "create":
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"task": "created"})
	case "update":
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"task": "updated"})
	case "delete":
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"task": "deleted"})
	case "assign":
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"task": "assigned"})
	case "complete":
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"task": "completed"})
	case "cancel":
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"task": "cancelled"})
	case "reopen":
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"task": "reopened"})
	case "archive":
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"task": "archived"})
	default:
		c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": "unknown action"})
	}
}
